about: The secreta of the formulary “Vigil of Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts offered, and cleanse our hearts by the illumination of the Holy Spirit. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the same Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: by the illumination of the Holy Spirit

ex.w005: The prayer asks the Lord to sanctify the gifts that have been offered.
ex.w012: The Lord is asked to cleanse our hearts through the illumination of the Holy Spirit.
